nom: La Roche-Posay Anthelios UV Hydra Sunscreen SPF 50 with Hyaluronic Acid

avis.texte: The best sunscreen. Lightweight acne friendly. Just awesome. High quality.

I loved this product in the winter. I have really dry skin and this product made my skin look so glowy and healthy. As I started sweating more in the summer, it started breaking me out in small pimples on my cheek and flared up my fungal acne on my forehead. I wish I could've loved this product in the summer as much as I did in the winter. ): I don't think I'll be repurchasing.

I love how this product gives on my skin feels very lightweight. However, the bottle absolutely sucks and I don't even think I'm gonna get all the product out because my bottle malfunction. :( and it's like a plastic bag inside the bottle so you can't even detach the pump

I've recently started caring about spf on my face. The problem is a I hate the feeling of sunscreen. This one is the best I've found so far, although I haven't tried under makeup yet. Love that it has HA, but does leave face a bit shiny/tacky

It felt like putting olive oil on my face. It never dried down and looked oily/over shiny. When I blotted with a tissue, the tissue stuck to my face, and when I pulled away all my makeup came with it. Gross feeling.

avis.titre: Makes my skin look like glass

I absolutely love this sunscreen. It's so light it doesn't feel greasy or drying but so light it doesn't feel like it's there.

While a bit pricy, this sunscreen delivers. It almost immediately melts into the skin, without leaving a white cast. I have confidence in the ingredients and the sunscreen properties as this brand is reputable and widely respected in Europe. Because of the price, I use this exclusively on my face and neck areas.

avis.titre: Good but not for oily skin or summer

avis.titre: Applies like a good facial moisturizer.

I did see notice little breakouts since I started using this sunscreen. Will be returning.
I wanted to like this due the price and reviews were good. For me, it just sits on top of my skin. All day. Long. Very greasy and gives my face an unwelcomed sheen.

avis.titre: I would buy this product. But be careful.

This is a good product, it is totally invisible and VERY hydrating. It pairs well for me while I use tret since it is so hydrating. However, it does sit on the skin as VERY oily. But it doesnt break me out and is light, so I'm leaning towards this being a good product that I will probably rebuy.
Sunscreen works well. It's lightweight and blends easily. Plus it's not greasy which is great. My old facial sunblock would get so greasy when out and about in the sun, this one does not.

Yes, it really is invisible! I have acne prone skin and it does not break me out. This is my favorite sunscreen to date! This is the first La Roche-Posay product I've used and it's making me want to try more!
Painfully dry lips, swelling in cheeks. Never had a reaction to an SPF quite like this.

avis.titre: Totally invisible, but unfortunately very greasy/oily

Found it to be super hydrating and absorbed right in to the skin and didn't leave any residue behind on the skin. The sun protection works enough for me.

avis.titre: YES I WOULD BUY THIS PRODUCT AGAIN

Good sun screen! No greasy, no white color, no allergy, no smell. I switch from Shiseido to this. However, I have not use it during really south east summer, hopefully it will block enough UV down south here. At least good for fall, wither and spring.

I have finally found a sunscreen for my face that does a great job protecting my skin from the sun AND doesn't cause breakouts! I have dry, sensitive skin and every single sunscreen I have ever tried has caused me to breakout with pimples. The Anthelios UV Hydra lotion is the perfect sunscreen for me! It has no fragrance, layers nicely with my other face products and makeup, and it hydrates my face without being oily and greasy.
I use sunscreen every day for decades and La Roche Posay for many years. This sunscreen with the Hyaluronic acid allows me to skip a step in my routine. I'm very happy with my purchase.

This felt nice going on but the second I tried to put a little makeup on it pilled like crazy. I'll probably throw it in my beach bag or maybe I'll use it on my chest and shoulders when I'm wearing a tank top or sundress but I'm not going to use it as a daily face sunscreen.

I struggle with finding sunscreens that don't leave a white cast and don't break you out. I've been using this daily (2-3x day) for a month now and I will 100% be repurchasing. No white cast, no breakouts. & it's light

This is a great product. Super lightweight and not greasy like other UV protection products. Absorbs in skin really well, keeping the skin protected and hydrated! Doesn't have a strong scent, but what it has is pleasant t
Eh, it looks, smells, and feels just like the eucerin sunscreen I had previously. It gets a little drippy during hot weather, and sticky after reapplying. Not worth the price
This is a good hydrating spf. I am a brown skin girl and it did not leave a cast on my face, which was a huge concern. It was moisturizing and didn't cause any breakouts. So far so good.

avis.titre: Possibly allergic to it??? Stings Eyes 👀
avis.texte: Quite disappointed. I've used the milk sunscreen which I had no reaction to, but for some reason I have a reaction to this one. It is more specific to face so you would think it might be gentler. It stings my eyes even if I apply it away from my eyes somehow it makes it to them and it's waterworks. I also get a runny nose from it. I really wanted to like this sunscreen since everything else seemed fine. Now it's turning into a neck and body sunscreen, or if I'm crazy to do more experiments I'll use it on my face.

I have naturally, really great skin. I've never had issues with prducts, but this caused my face to burn and took a few days to recover. It's possible I have an allergy to something in it, and I'm likel 1 in a million.

Moisturizing, lightweight and NOT greasy/oily! I have super sensitive skin and this does not break my face out. Thick enough but not too thick. Goes on like butter and my skin just soaks it all in! This will be great with spring/summer coming and for every day use!

First this was sent to me during a midwest winter so I cannot speak of the UV protection. I did wear it because it is supposed to be a moisturizer as well. My skin did feel moisturized but it felt a bit heavier than other moisturizers I've used, but it did feel lighter than most sunscreens.

Everyone that knows me knows that I always wear sunscreen, even in the winter. The only downside is that it's hard to find sunscreens that have a high SPF but don't leave that obnoxious white cast that we all dread. This is why I was thrilled to try the La Roche-Posay Daily Invisible Sunscreen. Keyword: Invisible. I was able to apply this without any white cast. It melted into my skin, leaving it moisturized and protected. It is lightweight and non-greasy so I didn't have to worry about it interfering with my makeup. If you're looking for a sunscreen that won't give you that dreaded white cast and moisturizes, this is the one for you.

I like that the product is light weight. A little goes a long way for full coverage for your face. It does have a light scent of sunscreen. It did seem to make my face appear shiny or dewy. I do feel it did provide sun coverage my face felt protected as it did not burn.

I have used this sunscreen few times. First it's not oily, tacky or ecky. It doesn't leave any residue on your skin. It blends in. I have been using another expensive sunscreen for couple of years. Once I'm through that, this will be my only sunscreen, plus I like the packaging more than other brand.

I received this product for free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I loved this facial sunscreen! It absorbs really nicely with no white cast and made my skin look amazing. I do think it wouldn't be appropriate for anyone with oily skin, though. It was very moisturizing!
The sunscreen goes on lightly, spreads evenly, and stays put through the day. I really love it. It is very different to compare with other brand I ever had. I definitely recommend this !!!

Overall this is not my favorite SPF. It does seem really hydrating but perhaps too much. It leaves that greasy feel after. I wanted to return but was beyond the 30 day window. Will not be repurchasing. I guess if you live in an arid climate this might work.
It's a good product. It is hydrating and not too greasy. I've been outside for extended periods a couple times while using and didn't burn or get red at all
This is the perfect daily anti-aging and sunscreen. My dermatologist says I should always be wearing uv protection and this is light enough to go under makeup. I'm very happy with this product.

This was way better than I expected. I have seen no white cast so far and I love that! I I also like that it smells lightly like sunscreen. Nothing overpowering. And it's so light weight, I see no residue like oil or grit.
This is most definitely a holy grail skincare item. This stuff is light and lumious. Plays well with make up and is spf 50! I will repurchase indefinitly.

I love the viscosity of this sunscreen! It's not too thick so it's easy to get full coverage without it leaving behind any streaks or residue. It only has that subtle sunscreen scent but it layers well with my other facial care products. It's not for applying any sort of powder after, as there is a slight tacky feeling, but it's not as noticeable as most other sun care products. All in all, I really enjoy this and will be sure to pack it on vacation next month!

Great Sunscreen. It is Really works. Sunscreen is a crucial step in my skincare regimen because I live in Florida. This sunscreen goes into the skin and blends in flawlessly with no white overcast. It's great to wear alone or under makeup. There is no strong fragrance so if you are sensitive you should be fine. The best part is that it doesn't leave a greasy feeling but leaves my skin feeling soft. And I like this cute and stylish packaging.
I was using Anthelios SX SPF15 for many years. I am happy to say UV Hydra has the same consistency and agrees with my sensitive skin. It makes your skin have a nice glow!! I also love the SPF 50!
This product has an amazing formula that is light on you skin and.doesnt make it feel heavy. A small amount goes a long way. I feel it provides great protection for your skin against the sun.

I'm so happy that I received this sunscreen to try from Influenster! I've been searching for a good sunscreen and I believe I have found my match. This one however (the Anthelios UV Hydra sunscreen) didn't give me that problem. It really did seem like an invisible sunscreen. I also LOVE that it has hyaluronic acid in it and that it is super moisturizing, because my face has been extremely dry this winter. I don't know if it's the cold weather or what, but my moisture barrier has been messed up and I need all the hydration I can get. This has felt so good on my face and I'm really happy that it's SPF 50 and not something lower. Thanks so much Influenster, I'm super pleased with this product!!!!!!

Great product, perfect size for travel just throw in the carry-on bag, and whats best is that a little bit goes a long way. I absolutely love the way my skin feels and I haven't had any issues with my makeup application either. I think it's safe to say I have a new spf and my skin is happy about that.

avis.titre: Wish i would have found this a lot sooner
avis.texte: LA Roche-Posay Anthelios UV Hydra sunscreen, and I must say, it has exceeded my expectations in every way. As someone who takes sun protection seriously, I'm always on the lookout for a sunscreen that offers both efficient sun protection and a lightweight, non-greasy formula, and this product delivered on all fronts. the sun protection offered by the Anthelios UV Hydra is phenomenal along with broad-spectrum SPF of 50+, I felt confident knowing that my skin was shielded from both UVA and UVB rays. Whether I was spending the day working in my yard or running errands around town, this sunscreen provided me with the peace of mind I needed. What sets this sunscreen apart from others on the market is its unique Hydra technology. The formula is enriched with hyaluronic acid, which works wonders in keeping my skin hydrated throughout the day. Unlike other sunscreens that tend to leave my skin feeling dry and tight, this one left my skin feeling moisturized and nourished. It's the perfect solution for those with dry or sensitive skin. Another aspect that impressed me was the texture of the product. The lightweight, non-greasy formula absorbed quickly into my skin, leaving behind no white cast or residue. It felt incredibly comfortable on my skin and didn't clog my pores or cause any breakouts. I also appreciate that it is fragrance-free, making it suitable for those with fragrance sensitivities. Not only does this sunscreen offer excellent sun protection and hydration, but it's also

The best of the best sun screen that anyone could buy. I love there products. There amazing. Good price. Even good put on the kids. Want be disappointed please that

I am obsessed with this product. It has totally helped the overall texture of my skin after one month of us. I'm ashamed to say that at 35, I have NOT used sunscreen on my fave regularly. But I'm changing that now!

I definitely recommend this as an SPF product over others. Especially if you're going to wear makeup.

And it's currently winter and not very sunny at all so I didn't really see the benefit to using it much during this time. It's an easy pump bottle, it took a few pumps to get anything out the very first time I tried to use it but thats normal. Its also unscented, but it has a very slight "sunscreen" scent to it which isn't that great to me. It also goes on well to the skin and doesn't make it sticky which is important, and 1 reason why I tend to not use sunscreen products. To summarize, it was decent for what it is and looking forward to trying more of it in the summer.
I love how light weight and spreadable this cream a on the skin. I removed a star from the rating simply for the smell. It has a slight perfume smell that I am not a fan of.

Love this product and how easy it is to apply on my face. I love the protection it has to offer as well definitely will be ordering this product again in the future

This cream is hydrating and has spf which is a great combination. It is not too heavy and doesn't seem greasy but goes on smooth. Good under make up or by it's self

avis.titre: Fabulous product, excellent sun protection for keeping yo...

This sunscreen moisturizer goes on so smooth and absorbs so nicely. A lot of other sun screens tend to make me oily and break out but not this one. Would definitely recommend for anyone with sensitive skin.
